title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Deposit Days and the Payment Record
content:
**Credit office deposit grid — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The deposit days of the additional deposit follow the agreement's payment record over the last twelve months — that is, entries whose date is fewer than twelve whole calendar months before the day the deposit is worked out.

| Payment record on the agreement in the last twelve months | Deposit days |
|---|---|
| At least 2 payments dishonored (the returned-payment limit, the same in every tier) | 60 — the days set for an agreement on certified funds |
| Fewer than 2 dishonored, and a late charge assessed | 45 — the days set for an agreement with a recent late charge |
| Neither | The security deposit days of the agreement's tier: 30 in every tier |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** Two dishonored payments, the earlier one 11 whole months and some days back: 60. The earlier one 12 whole months back: only one counts; with a late charge in the window, 45; without, 30.
